description: A repairman fixes washing machines and freezers. Each washing machine takes 30 minutes of inspection and 90 minutes of fixing time. Each freezer takes 20 minutes of inspection and 125 minutes of fixing time. The repairman has 5000 minutes available for inspection and 20000 minutes available in his schedule. If each washing machine repaired earns him $250 and each freezer repaired earns his $375, how many of each appliance should he fix to maximize his earnings?

InspectionTimeWashingMachine.definition: Time required to inspect one washing machine

FixingTimeWashingMachine.definition: Time required to fix one washing machine

InspectionTimeFreezer.definition: Time required to inspect one freezer

FixingTimeFreezer.definition: Time required to fix one freezer

objective.description: "Maximize the total earnings from repairing washing machines and freezers"

constraints.description: 30 * (Number of washing machines repaired) + 20 * (Number of freezers repaired) <= 5000
90 * (Number of washing machines repaired) + 125 * (Number of freezers repaired) <= 20000
constraints.code:
model.addConstr(
    FixingTimeWashingMachine * WashingMachinesRepaired
    + FixingTimeFreezer * FreezersRepaired
    <= TotalScheduleTime
)

constraints.description: Number of washing machines repaired >= 0, Number of freezers repaired >= 0
Number of washing machines repaired and Number of freezers repaired must be integers
